name: Verdant Tenacity (Floral)
body:
As you continue to explore your connection with growing things, you learn to flourish even in inhospitable environments.

Prerequisite(s): Improved Bond of Flora

Benefit(s): As your flesh increasingly turns into animate vegetation, you develop an intrinsic sense for how to thrive in even seemingly barren landscapes. Additionally, your toughened flesh allows you to focus better through pain or distraction. You gain a bonus on Survival checks and concentration checks equal to your total number of Floral feats.

Call of the Wild, Book 1 – The Druid. © 2017 d20pfsrd.com Publishing; Author: Kalen Tessmann
